cosmetics.name: Pit Crimson
cosmetics.desc: Deep red cloth, brass trim. Hides the stains.

cosmetics.name: Midnight Blue
cosmetics.desc: The colour of the lower levels.

cosmetics.name: Glowcap Green
cosmetics.desc: Dyed with crushed cave moss.

cosmetics.name: Bone White
cosmetics.desc: Pale armour. Brave, down here.

cosmetics.name: Ash and Blood
cosmetics.desc: Charcoal plate with red edging.

cosmetics.name: Royal Violet
cosmetics.desc: Guild purple and gold. You have to earn the nerve.

cosmetics.name: Cinder
cosmetics.desc: Charcoal and furnace orange.

cosmetics.name: Sewer Venom
cosmetics.desc: Black-green plate with acid edging.

cosmetics.name: Rime
cosmetics.desc: Ice-blue and white. Shows every drop.

cosmetics.name: Black and Gilt
cosmetics.desc: Lamp-black armour with gold at every edge.

cosmetics.name: Gambler’s Brim
cosmetics.desc: A wide hat with a long feather.

cosmetics.name: Fool’s Cap
cosmetics.desc: Three points, three bells. They never see it coming.

cosmetics.name: Stag Antlers
cosmetics.desc: A full rack, lashed to a leather band.

cosmetics.name: Crown of Thorns
cosmetics.desc: Black iron briar. It bites the wearer too.

cosmetics.name: Marc’s Lucky Laurel
cosmetics.desc: Won from Marc in a friendly. He says it is lucky. He lost while wearing it.

cosmetics.name: Old Rust
cosmetics.desc: Iron left in the wet. It suits the place.

cosmetics.name: Bone and Black
cosmetics.desc: Ivory plate over black cloth, with a red edge.

cosmetics.name: Guild Violet
cosmetics.desc: The Guild’s own colour. Wearing it is a statement.

cosmetics.name: House Colours
cosmetics.desc: Long Odds green and gold. You are a walking advertisement.

cosmetics.name: Deep Cowl
cosmetics.desc: A heavy hood. Nobody sees where you are looking.

cosmetics.name: Pit Crest
cosmetics.desc: A stiff dyed crest. The crowd can find you from the back row.

cosmetics.name: Lampwright’s Crown
cosmetics.desc: A ring of lit candles. Hot wax is part of the look.

cosmetics.name: High Roller’s Crown
cosmetics.desc: Gold band, four wispdice. Marc wore it once and lost a house.

cosmetics.name: First Blood
cosmetics.desc: Deed: First Blood. Dried red over black.

cosmetics.name: Pit Stone
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Mason. The colour of the wall you keep putting people into.

cosmetics.name: The Pale Queen’s Colours
cosmetics.desc: Deed: The Guttercrown. White, violet and gold. Hers, until you.

cosmetics.name: Executioner’s Hood
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Executioner. Black, pointed, two red eyes.

cosmetics.name: Horned Helm
cosmetics.desc: Two great curved horns.

cosmetics.name: Plague Beak
cosmetics.desc: A long leather beak and glass eyes.

cosmetics.name: Skull Visor
cosmetics.desc: Somebody else’s face, worn over yours.

cosmetics.name: Victor’s Laurel
cosmetics.desc: Gilded leaves for a proven winner.

cosmetics.name: Pretender’s Crown
cosmetics.desc: Not the real one. Yet.

cosmetics.name: Bedroll and Quiver
cosmetics.desc: Everything you own, on your back.

cosmetics.name: Fur Greatcloak
cosmetics.desc: Heavy, long, and collared in fur.

cosmetics.name: Back Banner
cosmetics.desc: Your colours flying behind you.

cosmetics.name: Raven Wings
cosmetics.desc: Black feathers on an iron frame.

cosmetics.name: Spare Greatsword
cosmetics.desc: A second blade across your back, for the look of it.

cosmetics.name: Lantern Pole
cosmetics.desc: Your own lamp, carried high. Down here that means something.

cosmetics.name: Trophy Rack
cosmetics.desc: Three skulls on iron spikes.

cosmetics.name: Bloodletter
cosmetics.desc: Red to the hilt, and it stays that way.

cosmetics.name: Sewer-Quenched
cosmetics.desc: A sick green shine.

cosmetics.name: Javelin Quiver
cosmetics.desc: Three short spears you will never throw.

cosmetics.name: Mistake’s Cousin
cosmetics.desc: A rat in a cage on your back. He is not fast either.

cosmetics.name: Sack of Winnings
cosmetics.desc: A fat sack with coin spilling from the neck. Mostly washers.

cosmetics.name: Rimed Edge
cosmetics.desc: Pale as lake ice.

cosmetics.name: Voidsteel
cosmetics.desc: Black metal with a violet burn in it.

cosmetics.name: Wisplight Edge
cosmetics.desc: The same light the dice are made of, on a blade.

cosmetics.name: Crowd’s Pennants
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Crowd Favourite. Two flags they threw down to you.

cosmetics.name: Mirror Polish
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Deflector. Bright enough to parry by.

cosmetics.name: Partner’s Edge
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Silent Partner. Green with a gold shine, like Marc’s promises.

cosmetics.name: Obsidian
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Posture Breaker. Black glass with a red heart.

cosmetics.name: Old Bronze
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Heavy Hand. The metal the first pit fighters used.

cosmetics.name: Emberforged
cosmetics.desc: The edge glows like a coal.

cosmetics.name: Frostbitten
cosmetics.desc: Cold enough to smoke.

cosmetics.name: Gilded
cosmetics.desc: Gold leaf over good steel.

cosmetics.name: Voidglass
cosmetics.desc: Purple-black and faintly humming.

cosmetics.name: Ember Motes
cosmetics.desc: Sparks that follow you around.

cosmetics.name: Grave Mist
cosmetics.desc: A cold blue haze at your feet.

cosmetics.name: Violet Sigils
cosmetics.desc: Guild-work glyphs that orbit you.

cosmetics.name: Rime Fall
cosmetics.desc: A cold white drift that never settles.

cosmetics.name: Red Mist
cosmetics.desc: It followed you out of the pit.

cosmetics.name: Lamp Moths
cosmetics.desc: They think you are the First Lamp.

cosmetics.name: Glowcap Spores
cosmetics.desc: Do not breathe in. Marc does.

cosmetics.name: Loose Wisps
cosmetics.desc: Escaped from the table. They like you.

cosmetics.name: Afterimage
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Not There. Pale echoes of where you just were.

cosmetics.name: Untouched Light
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Untouched. Nothing has laid a hand on you.

cosmetics.name: Hearth Glow
cosmetics.desc: Deed: House Proud. You smell faintly of a good fire.

cosmetics.name: Forge Steam
cosmetics.desc: Deed: Immovable. You run hot.

cosmetics.name: Halo of Coin
cosmetics.desc: The crowd’s favour, made visible.

cosmetics.name: Voss’s Band
cosmetics.desc: Won from Ferren Voss, twice. A teal fighting-band with a brass ring.

rings.name: Cinder Ring
rings.desc: The first thing your blood does on its own: a circle of embers it will not let you step out of.

rings.name: Wet Glass
rings.desc: Cold blue light out of the Wet Galleries, where the water has not moved in a hundred years.

rings.name: The Stormcall
rings.desc: A ring of lightning teeth: the Ember Rows still say a storm-born child crackles in the cradle.

rings.name: Wyrm’s Eye
rings.desc: Your blood remembers something with scales. Now the sand under you does too.

rings.name: Pale Crown
rings.desc: A Koheneim mandala, the Queen’s own sign. Nobody gave it to you. You simply have one now.

rings.name: Ash Circle
rings.desc: What is left on the floor after the first bargain: a ring of ash that never quite blows away.

rings.name: The Signed Line
rings.desc: The clause you signed, written round you in a hand that is not yours, still checking you keep it.

rings.name: Teeth Below
rings.desc: The thing under the pit opens its mouth a little wider each time you call on it.

rings.name: The Bargain Seal
rings.desc: Your patron’s own seal, pressed into the sand. Others in the pact can see it from a long way off.

rings.name: Name Unspoken
rings.desc: Seven points for seven letters you promised never to say aloud. It glows a little brighter every time you nearly do.

rings.name: The Roseinbeirg Hourmark
rings.desc: David’s own. Nobody else stands on it twice.

stances.name: Parade Rest
stances.sub: Upright, one hand behind the back

stances.name: The Long Line
stances.sub: Side-on, blade raised, off hand behind

stances.name: Gutter Guard
stances.sub: Fists up, chin down, always moving

stances.name: Tavern Lean
stances.sub: On the shoulder, hand on the hip

stances.name: Stillness
stances.sub: Hanging in the air, nothing more

stances.name: The Seated Hour
stances.sub: Legs folded under, hands on the knees

stances.name: Open Hands
stances.sub: Arms wide, head back, toes down

stances.name: The Recline
stances.sub: Lying back on nothing, arms folded

stances.name: The Coil
stances.sub: One knee drawn up, one hand out

stances.name: The Drowned
stances.sub: Limp, head on one side, turning slowly
